ModMetaData.name: Bark Head East Fix — Vanilla Races Expanded: Phytokin
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Supplies the missing east-facing head texture for a female Phytokin with bark skin and a heavy jaw, in Vanilla Races Expanded - Phytokin.
The art was never missing. It is in the donor's own folder, saved under the male head's filename with " copy" appended, so the game never looks for it. This mod ships those exact bytes at the filename the donor's own HeadTypeDef asks for. Nothing was drawn, re-encoded or resized.
WHAT THE PLAYER SEES WITHOUT IT
A female Phytokin carrying both VRE_BarkSkin and Jaw_Heavy renders a FRONT-FACING HEAD ON A SIDE-FACING BODY, in both east and west. RimWorld's Graphic_Multi, finding no east texture, fills the slot from the north view at -90 degrees, and west is then mirrored from that. A whole head, on a colonist, every time she walks horizontally.
No log line is possible. "Failed to find any textures at" fires only when EVERY direction of a Graphic_Multi is absent, and this set has north and south. One missing direction is a silent substitution.
CONTENTS
Things/Pawn/Humanlike/Heads/BarkSkinFemale_Wide_Normal_east The east view of the female Wide bark head. 256x256, 5,372 bytes, 9,007 pixels inked (13.74% of the canvas), subject bounding box (75, 80) to (180, 189). Byte-for-byte the donor's own Textures/Things/Pawn/Humanlike/Heads/BarkSkin_Wide_Normal_east copy.png.
THE DONOR'S ORIGINAL: absent. The mod ships 30 head textures — ten sets of north, east and south — and every one of them is healthy, 256x256 and non-blank. Exactly one file is missing and exactly one file is spare, and they are the same file under two names.
HOW WE KNOW THE " copy" IS THE FEMALE HEAD AND NOT A STRAY DUPLICATE
This is the whole risk in the fix, so it is proved from the donor's own pixels rather than assumed from the filename. The male-to-female edit in this mod is a fixed, RGB-only retouch in the lip region: alpha is untouched, so the two silhouettes are identical and only a small cluster of colour pixels moves. Four of the five head sets ship BOTH genders' east view and serve as controls.
set male -> female differs bounding box Average 90 px (145,131)-(164,146) ElongatedHead 90 px (145,131)-(164,147) Narrow 92 px ( 87,124)-(164,146) Gaunt 100 px ( 76,114)-(164,150)
Wide: male east -> " copy" 91 px (145,131)-(164,147)
The suspect's difference from the male Wide east is 91 pixels in exactly the region where the known male-to-female edits land — Jaccard overlap 0.97 against ElongatedHead, 0.93 against Average, 0.91 against Narrow. Alpha delta is zero, so it is the same pose and the same silhouette, not a different drawing. It is the female head.
The two files also differ by md5 (647df98a... for the male, 7e0b47d9... for the copy), so this is not a duplicate someone left behind.
The check is shipped in Source/make_bark_female_wide_east.py and runs before the copy: if the alpha channel had moved, or the delta had failed to co-locate with a control, it refuses to write anything.
WHERE THE DEF IS
Vanilla Races Expanded - Phytokin's own HeadTypeDef names the correct path:
1.6/Defs/HeadTypeDefs/HeadTypeDefs.xml line 84 defName VRE_BarkHeavy_Female line 86 graphicPath Things/Pawn/Humanlike/Heads/BarkSkinFemale_Wide_Normal gender Female requiredGenes VRE_BarkSkin + Jaw_Heavy
HeadTypeDef has no graphicClass field and no facing control of any kind — zero hits for graphicClass, visibleFacing, drawSize or renderNodeProperties across this mod's HeadTypeDefs and across every vanilla HeadTypeDef. Head graphics are hardcoded Graphic_Multi with all four rotations, west mirrored from east. Nothing licenses a missing east; this is an oversight, not a choice.
LOAD ORDER MATTERS HERE
Vanilla Races Expanded - Phytokin ships its textures LOOSE, at the mod root: loadFolders.xml declares "/" and "1.6", the 1.5 and 1.6 folders contain no PNGs, and there is no AssetBundles folder anywhere in the mod. Between two loose files at the same path RimWorld resolves by load order, so this mod must load AFTER the donor. That is the opposite of an AssetBundle override, where a loose file wins regardless of order.
If Vanilla Races Expanded - Phytokin ever ships the file under its correct name, this mod becomes a harmless no-op supplying the same bytes, and can be unsubscribed.
